context: This criteria evaluates whether the solution correctly uses the request package to make basic HTTP GET requests with callbacks and properly handles response data including status codes and error handling.

checklist.name: Request import
checklist.description: Correctly imports and uses the request package

checklist.name: GET method usage
checklist.description: Uses request.get() or request() with GET method to make HTTP requests

checklist.name: Callback handling
checklist.description: Implements callback function with (error, response, body) parameters

checklist.name: Status code access
checklist.description: Accesses response.statusCode to determine HTTP status

checklist.name: Error handling
checklist.description: Properly checks for errors in the callback and handles network/request failures

checklist.name: Multiple requests
checklist.description: Correctly handles multiple URLs by making separate request calls
